name: mcp-commander-ideas
description: Design ideation and brainstorming cartridge. Provides tools for generating design alternatives, capturing ideas, and exploring manufacturing methods.

tools.name: generate_alternatives
tools.description: Generate alternative design approaches for a given design intent

tools.name: explore_manufacturing_methods
tools.description: Explore uncommon or non-traditional manufacturing methods for a design

tools.name: capture_idea
tools.description: Capture and store a design idea with metadata for later retrieval

tools.name: search_ideas
tools.description: Search stored design ideas by keyword, category, or project

tools.name: cross_domain_transfer
tools.description: Transfer design solutions from one industry domain to another
